title: Principal / Associate Principal SDET
description: Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit www.saviynt.com. We are seeking a Principal / Associate Principal SDET to lead the architecture and evolution of our automation and quality engineering strategy for Saviynt’s cloud-native Identity Security platform. In this role, you will partner with Engineering, Product, and SRE teams to design scalable test frameworks, drive automation-first development, and ensure the reliability, security, and performance of our platform. You will also champion the adoption of AI-powered development and testing tools to accelerate engineering productivity and improve software quality. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING Test Architecture & Automation Architect and evolve enterprise-scale automation frameworks across APIs, web UI, and backend services. Define and execute automation strategies supporting Saviynt’s identity platform (IGA, PAM, AAG, ISPM, NHI, RBAC, secrets management). Establish an automation roadmap aligned with product scalability, reliability, and security goals. AI-Driven Test Innovation Lead adoption of AI-powered developer tools (Amazon Q Developer, Cursor, test intelligence platforms). Develop intelligent automation capabilities to improve test generation, maintenance, and diagnostics. Quality Engineering Strategy Drive testing across functional, regression, performance, security, and resiliency scenarios. Implement shift-left testing by integrating automation and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code workflows. Continuously improve test stability, observability, and feedback loops. Platform & Pipeline Quality Partner with Engineering and SRE to identify coverage gaps, reliability risks, and release quality metrics. Optimize CI/CD pipelines and automated testing workflows to enable rapid, safe releases. Technical Leadership Conduct technical reviews of automation frameworks, test architecture, and engineering processes. Mentor and guide global QE teams to increase automation maturity and engineering excellence. Champion an automation-first culture across the organization WHAT YOU BRING 9+ years of experience in software test automation, including 5+ years in an architect or technical leadership role. Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Amazon Q Developer or Cursor. Strong experience designing scalable test automation frameworks using tools such as Playwright, PyTest, Robot Framework, or Karate. Strong programming skills in Java and Python (Groovy a plus). Experience testing REST APIs, microservices, and distributed cloud systems (AWS, GCP, Azure). Deep knowledge of CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitLab CI) and build tools (Maven, Gradle). Experience with database validation, test data management, and large-scale automation. Knowledge of performance testing(JMeter, Gatling). Familiarity with security and accessibility testing (SAST, DAST, WCAG, axe-core). Excellent communication and leadership skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams Saviynt is an amazing place to work. We are a high-growth, Platform as a Service company focused on Identity Authority to power and protect the world at work. You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work which directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. If you're resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic environment you belong with us! title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description: About Sift Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more. Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems. About the Role Engineers rely on real-time alerts to know the moment something goes wrong. You will own correctness test coverage for real-time alerting, from launch through every later release: proving that alerts fire when they should, and only then. That runs from the screens where users configure and review alerts to the backend services that evaluate them. Later, you will also cover our integration products: an edge database and viewer that runs on customer machines, our SDKs, command-line tool and data import pipelines. You will work with the Head of Quality Engineering and partner closely with the engineering teams that build these products. In This Role, You'll: Own alert correctness. Build tests that prove alerts fire when they should, and only then, across conditions, thresholds, rolling windows and severities. Build independent test data. Generate realistic data and alert scenarios that do not depend on the code under test. Own end-to-end UI testing. Build and maintain browser tests for alert configuration, alert history and status views. Keep them fast, stable and trusted. Validate what users see. Add visual regression checks for status indicators, severity levels, previews and dashboards where they add signal without flakiness. Test the APIs underneath. Write integration tests for backend services against a real database, covering the main paths and the edge cases a design implies but does not spell out. Test authorization thoroughly. Verify who can view, create and change data under role-based, attribute-based and resource-scoped permissions, including the negative cases. Test time-series evaluation. Verify alert logic on real-time data, including late, missing and out-of-order data, backfill, and recovery after a backlog. Compare old and new systems. Validate a new system's results against the one it replaces using generated or anonymized data, and test outbound integrations such as webhooks. Gate alert releases. Define what correctness results block an alerts release, sign off on it, and report risks to the team. Cover our integration products. Map coverage gaps and build regression tests for an offline-first edge database and viewer, our SDKs, command-line tool and data imports, including install and upgrade testing in Sift test environments. Train and guide a QE in another time zone. Onboard a QE who runs regression overnight, and review their results. Shape quality before code merges. Review designs and test plans with engineers, find gaps by reading the code, and raise risks early in plain language. Required Skills: 5+ years in QA automation or SDET roles, covering both UI and backend testing. Strong Playwright and TypeScript skills. You have designed suites, not only written tests. Experience writing integration tests for backend services, ideally in Go, against a real database. Python for test data generation and scripting. Experience testing authorization and access control: roles, attributes and resource-level permissions (RBAC, ABAC). Experience testing time-series or event data, including late, missing and out-of-order data. Strong SQL skills, including setting up test data and reasoning about data access rules. Ability to read production code and design documents to find untested paths. Experience testing SDKs, CLIs or APIs that customers integrate with, ideally in Python or Rust. Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English (CEFR B2 or above), used daily for design reviews, test plans, risk reports, working with and training teammates. At least 4 hours a day of overlap with US Pacific time. Bonus Points: Visual regression testing with a review tool such as Chromatic, or with Playwright screenshots. Testing Kafka-compatible streaming systems. Familiarity with monitoring, alerting or time-series data products. Using AI agents to write and maintain tests. Reading Rust. Testing software that runs on customer hardware or offline. Engineering At Sift: E2E and browser: Playwright, TypeScript Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vitest, Testing Library Backend and API: Go, gRPC, PostgreSQL Integrations and edge: Rust, Python, Protobuf Test data and scripting: Python Streaming: Kafka-compatible event streaming CI: GitHub Actions Location: This is a remote, full-time-equivalent independent contractor engagement for candidates based in Latin America or the Caribbean. You will work at least 4 hours a day overlapping with US Pacific time and collaborate closely with engineering teams in California. Compensation range: $4,000 - $4,500 USD per month (Latin America and the Caribbean) Candidates who advance will complete a standardized English assessment administered by a third-party provider. We will share how your results are used and stored, and request your consent, before the assessment.

Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors. Decompose requirements to design and implement automated testing approaches. Investigate and resolve automation failures by identifying root causes. Strong proficiency in Core Java programming. Hands-on experience with Automation Frameworks such as Selenium/playwright and Unit Testing Frameworks like TestNG. Expertise in creating and enhancing test plans, methodologies, and frameworks , including translating functional and non-functional requirements into test scenarios. Solid understanding of application architecture and system integrations. Strong debugging skills and ability to isolate defects effectively. Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. Familiarity with DevOps tools (CI/CD pipelines) is a plus. Exposure to white-box and gray-box testing with understanding of software design principles.
